| # | Author | Issue | Status |
|---|--------|-------|--------|
| 1 | Copilot | Reuse `isGeminiFormat` variable | Already fixed (commit `308738aa`) |
| 2 | cursor[bot] | Gemini token usage counts all messages (High) | Already fixed - `checkpointTranscriptStart` is passed through |
| 3 | cursor[bot] | Claude Code ignores startOffset (Medium) | Already fixed - lines 441-444 now slice using offset |
| 4 | cursor[bot] | Gemini prompts missing IDE tag stripping (Medium) | Already fixed - lines 393-400 now strip tags |
| 5 | cursor[bot] | Removed content-based Gemini fallback (Low) | Already fixed - `AgentTypeUnknown` tries Gemini parsing |
| 6 | cursor[bot] | Summary scoping uses line-based slicing on Gemini JSON (Medium) | **Fixed now** - skip line-based slicing for Gemini |

The only outstanding issue was #6: `transcript.SliceFromLine` was using line-based slicing on Gemini JSON transcripts where `CheckpointTranscriptStart` is a message index, not a line offset. For Gemini, the full transcript is now passed to the summarizer (the summarizer only supports JSONL anyway, so it will gracefully skip Gemini transcripts).
